value: Security features and supporting hardware infrastructure
data_security_requirements.quote: WorkSafeBC is a public body subject to FIPPA. All service providers to WorkSafeBC are also subject to FIPPA in the performance of services, regardless of their jurisdiction or privacy policies otherwise in place. Respondents should carefully review Appendix C to the Form of Proposal prior to determining whether to submit a Proposal. Appendix C must be comprehensively answered in any Proposal. ... Maintenance services include the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Solution, including security features and supporting hardware infrastructure. ... IT Security Requirements 15% ... Phase four – Privacy Impact Assessment: Prior to selection as the Preferred Respondent, the lead Respondent will be required to complete a Privacy Impact Assessment as described in Appendix C to the Form of Proposal. Phase four will be evaluated on a pass or fail basis. A pass must be achieved on both the Privacy Impact Assessment and the SAQ (as defined in Appendix C to the Form of Proposal). A Respondent who fails to complete the Privacy Impact Assessment or SAQ, or that WorkSafeBC determines in its sole discretion does not meet WorkSafeBC's privacy standards or security standards, will fail phase four and be disqualified from the RFP process.
